text.en:
Promote the Philippine Family Planning Program as a
government program through advocacy activities, the vigorous
and sustained participation of local officials in program management, the
use of local facilities, the services of local service providers and other
local employees, and utilization of other local resources and expertise.

Ensure that information on and services for all methods
including Natural Family Planning endorsed by the program are available
at appropriate
levels of service outlets, adhering to the standards of
quality of care promulgated by the national program.

Ensure that the practice of family planning is purely on a
basis, based on freedom of conscience and respect for the
sanctity of life.

Provide the necessary budgetary support to the program,

3 -

Coordinate
with and seek the assistance of national
agencies, particularly
the Department of Health, and members of the
Population
Commission,
who are involved
in the Philippine
Planning Program.

Coordinate
and encourage the involvement
government
organizations
and the private commercial
sector in the
Philippine Family Planning Program, in the spirit of public-private
partnership.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28!h day of February in the year
of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Six.
By the President:
PMS LI BRARY.
